title: Turning words into diagrams for ChatGPT

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Describe a diagram in plain text and get a picture back. That was the idea behind a ChatGPT plugin Antoine worked on.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: D2COpenAIPlugin is a small FastAPI service with a plugin manifest and an OpenAPI description, so ChatGPT knew how to call it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And where do the pictures come from?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: From existing diagram engines. The service looks at the diagram language in the request and sends it down the right path: PlantUML, Mermaid or Kroki.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So it's a router, in a way.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A friendly one. Same endpoint, several backends, and the caller never needs to care which one did the drawing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It's all Python, under the MIT license.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A neat example of a thin service that connects a chat assistant to real tools. The page has the full breakdown.
